legend: You are given a maze that consists of a grid of N×M$$$N \times M$$$ (3≤N,M≤30$$$3 \leq N, M \leq 30$$$) rooms. Any two rooms that are adjacent by a side are connected by a bidirectional colored corridor. There are only four colors that the corridors can be painted: red, green, blue, and yellow.

One of the rooms in the maze is the starting room, and one is the ending room. You can only move between adjacent rooms through the connecting corridors. You are allowed to move through a corridor into another room and then return. As you move, a sequence of your moves is formed. When you move forward, the color of the corridor you are passing through is added to the sequence, and when you move back, the last element is removed from the sequence. However, there is one restriction: you cannot pass through a corridor of color C$$$C$$$ if among the last three elements of the sequence there is C$$$C$$$.

Neither the maze, the starting position, nor the ending position are known to the participant. You need to reach the ending room from the starting room. It is guaranteed that the ending room is reachable.

At the beginning, the jury program outputs two numbers N$$$N$$$ and M$$$M$$$. Then for each move the participant makes, the jury program outputs the success of that step or asks to end the program if the participant has reached the ending room.
Each move must be one of these commands:
"MOVE LEFT" — if you want to go to the room located to the left of you;
"MOVE RIGHT" — if you want to go to the room located to the right of you;
"MOVE UP" — if you want to go to the room located above you;
"MOVE DOWN" — if you want to go to the room located below you;
The jury program will reply with one of these:
"OK" — if your move was successful and you moved to another room;
"FAIL" — if your move was unsuccessful, meaning you tried to pass through a corridor of an invalid color or tried to go back with an empty sequence;
"EXIT" — if you have reached the ending room.
Starting from test 22$$$22$$$, the jury's program is adaptive to the participant's program output.
The total number of moves must not exceed 100000$$$100\,000$$$.
note: In the first test, the jury has the following maze:

Black dots represent rooms. The corridors between rooms are represented by lines. The letter next to the corridor indicates its color ("Y" — yellow, "R" — red, "G" — green, "B" — blue). Initially, the participant is in the room marked with a bold dot. Next to the room that is the final destination for the participant is the letter "X". Neither the maze, nor the starting position, nor the ending position are known to the participant.
The first command is BACK, but since there have been no moves yet, nothing happens. The jury program reports that the move was unsuccessful ("FAIL").
The second command is MOVE DOWN. After this, the sequence of colors of the passed corridors will be: "yellow".
The movement is shown in the picture below.

The next command is MOVE LEFT. With this command, the participant tries to pass through the yellow corridor, which is already the last in the sequence, so the jury informs that the move was unsuccessful.
The next command is MOVE RIGHT. The sequence of colors now becomes: "yellow, blue". The movement is shown in the picture below.

In the next three commands, the participant attempts to pass through corridors of blue or yellow colors, which are already included in the last three elements of the sequence, so the jury reports that those moves are unsuccessful.
The following command is BACK. The sequence of moves is: "yellow".
The next command is BACK again. The sequence of moves is: "" (empty).
The next command is MOVE UP. The sequence of moves will be "blue". Since the participant reached the ending room, the jury asks the participant to end the program.

legend.ai: 给定一个由 N×M$$$N \times M$$$ 个房间组成的网格迷宫，其中 3≤N,M≤30$$$3 \leq N, M \leq 30$$$。任意两个共边相邻的房间之间都有一条双向的彩色走廊相连。走廊只有四种可涂成的颜色：红色、绿色、蓝色和黄色。
迷宫中的一个房间是起点房间，另一个是终点房间。你只能通过相连的走廊在相邻房间之间移动。你可以沿走廊进入另一个房间，然后再返回。移动过程中，会形成一个由你的移动组成的序列。当你向前移动时，经过的走廊颜色会被添加到序列中；当你返回时，序列中的最后一个元素会被删除。但是有一条限制：如果序列的最后三个元素中包含 C$$$C$$$，则你不能通过颜色为 C$$$C$$$ 的走廊。
参与者不知道迷宫、起始位置和终止位置。你需要从起点房间到达终点房间。保证终点房间可以到达。
开始时，评测程序会输出两个数 N$$$N$$$ 和 M$$$M$$$。随后，对于参与者进行的每次移动，评测程序都会输出该步是否成功；如果参与者已经到达终点房间，则要求结束程序。
每次移动必须是以下命令之一：
"MOVE LEFT" —— 如果你想前往位于你左侧的房间；
"MOVE RIGHT"——如果你想前往位于你右侧的房间；
"MOVE UP"——如果你想前往位于你上方的房间；
"MOVE DOWN"——如果你想前往位于你下方的房间；
评测程序将回复以下内容之一：
"OK"——如果你的移动成功，并且你移动到了另一个房间；
“FAIL”——如果你的移动失败了，即你尝试通过颜色无效的走廊，或尝试在序列为空时返回；
从第 22 个测试$$$22$$$开始，评测程序会根据参赛者程序的输出进行自适应调整。

note.ai: 在第一个测试中，评测程序使用如下迷宫：
黑点表示房间。房间之间的走廊用线表示。走廊旁的字母表示其颜色（“Y”——黄色，“R”——红色，“G”——绿色，“B”——蓝色）。开始时，参与者位于带有粗体黑点标记的房间内。参与者的最终目的地房间旁标有字母“X”。参与者事先不知道迷宫、起始位置和终点位置。
第一条指令是 BACK，但由于尚未进行任何移动，因此什么也没有发生。评测程序报告移动失败（“FAIL”）。
第二条指令是 MOVE DOWN。执行后，已经通过的走廊颜色序列将为：“黄色”。
下一条指令是 MOVE LEFT。执行该指令时，参与者尝试通过黄色走廊，而黄色走廊已经是序列中的最后一条，因此评测程序告知此次移动失败。
下一个指令是向右移动。颜色序列现在变为：“黄色，蓝色”。移动过程如下图所示。
在接下来的三个指令中，参赛者尝试通过蓝色或黄色的走廊，而这些颜色已经包含在序列的最后三个元素中，因此评测方报告称这些移动均未成功。
接下来的指令是返回。移动序列为：“黄色”。
下一个指令仍然是返回。移动序列为：“”（空）。
下一个指令是向上移动。移动序列将为“蓝色”。由于参赛者已经到达终点房间，评测方要求参赛者结束程序。
